- (b) sporting events held in and outside Delhi.  
Period in excess of 30/10 days in a year will be treated as a regular leave.  
Players injured during sporting events.Special Casual Leave may also be granted to a sportsperson getting seriously injured or being hospitalized during the Telecom Sporting events subject to the overall ceiling of 30 days in a calendar year admissible for sporting events.
